notes:
CRM notes (fragments):
- Account: DoD-affiliated research org, multi-site (CONUS). Very procurement-heavy.
- Primary problem: search across classified/unclassified document stores with strict air-gapped processing for classified tier. Need embeddings + reranking pipeline that can run on-prem without outbound connections.
- Scale: target index ~25M docs initially, growth to 200M+ over 12-18 months. Mixed short query latency (operator queries) and high-throughput batch reranks for analytic workflows.
- Latency/throughput targets: 95thpct <150ms for <=512 token queries on operator tier; bulk rerank throughput 10k qps target during nightly analytics window. Cost sensitivity moderate-high: fixed budget for dedicated hardware -> want deterministic token/unit economics.
- Model preferences: open-source model family with available quantization (e.g., Llama-3 variants or similar). Must support reranker head or compatibility with lightweight cross-encoders.
- Routing/fallback: require policy to fallback to lower-cost quantized variant if high-latency or OOM; strict policy that no data leaves the air-gapped environment.
- Security: SSO via SAML for internal users; KMS integration (HSM preferred); immutable audit logs and 7+ year retention for certain categories. CMMC alignment required; FedRAMP not strictly required but helpful.
- Notes from 2026-02-18 call: 'we can't accept any outbound telemetry by default' — customer open to opt-in telemetry on isolated admin host.
- Procurement note: will run an RFx; timeline tied to funding quarter (Q3 FY26).
- POC asks: reproducible on-prem install artifact (air-gap install bundle + SBOM), sample embedding performance for quantized model, reranker accuracy eval vs their labeled query set (10k queries).
- Action items: provide hardened air-gapped deployment checklist, updated SOW with breakouts for POC vs production, kill-switch/offline telemetry plan, and sample cost-per-query scenarios (3 hardware configs).
- Internal: coordinate with Infra Eng (on-prem packaging) and Security (SBOM + attestation). SE Diego to produce perf estimates by 2026-03-16.
- Quote from CISO: 'We need predictable tail latency and a deployable package that our integrators can sign-off within 2 sprints.'
- Risk: export-control review may delay by extra 4 weeks depending on selected model weights.
